 Many state forest departments in India have released the Forest Department Recruitment 2026 notification on their official websites. Forest Recruitment 2026 has been announced to recruit candidates for posts, including forest ranger, forest watcher, wildlife guard, and more. Candidates can check out the official websites to know more about the forest recruitment 2026.
 Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Apply Online: Latest Forest Govt Jobs Vacancy
 Candidates can check out this page to know all the important details about the Forest Department Recruitment 2026, including state-wise vacancies announced, eligibility, salary, selection process, important dates, application process, and more. As different state forest departments and recruitment boards will announce new vacancies throughout the years, candidates preparing for the forest department exam regularly visit the official websites of different state forest departments to know the new vacancies announced.
 Candidates can check out this page, as we also update the latest updates regarding the Forest Department Recruitment 2026 whenever new vacancies are announced by different state forest departments and recruitment boards. As we update the latest forest recruitment regularly, candidates can visit this page regularly to know all the vacancies announced across all states in India instead of visiting all state forest department websites.

 The eligibility for each post is detailed in the official notification. Candidates are advised to visit the Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Official Website to know the eligibility criteria for the posts announced. Candidates who meet the eligibility requirements can apply for the posts announced.
 The eligibility criteria for each post involve age limit, educational qualifications, nationality, experience, and more. Check out the table below to know the eligibility criteria for the posts announced.

 Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Eligibility
 Post/Exam Name
 Forest Recruitment Eligibility Criteria
 Forest Watcher
 Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Age Limit:
 18 - 30 years for General/Unreserved Category;
 18 - 32 Years for 2A, 2B, 3A, and 3B (Backward Classes)
 18 - 33 Years for SC, ST, and Category - I
 Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Educational Qualification:
 Applicants must have cleared the SSLC examination conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board or Class 10 conducted by CBSE or ICSE or education boards of other state governments.
 Applicants must have completed a secondary-level course conducted by the NIOS or Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board.
 Nationality:
 Applicants must be Indian citizens.
 Kolara Tourism Gate Manager
 Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Age Limit:
 The minimum age limit is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is not specified.
 Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Educational Qualification:
 Applicants must complete their graduation from a recognised board.
 Elephant Kavadiga
 Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Age Limit:
 18 - 35 for General Category
 18 - 38 Years for 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B and other Backward Classes
 18 - 40 Years for SC, ST, and Category - I
 Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Educational Qualification:
 No educational qualification is specified in the official notification. Therefore, no need to submit educational certificates.
 Nationality and Domicile:
 Applicants must be Indian and reside near the notified forest area.
 Experience:
 Applicants must have experience in elephant handling.
 Language Known:
 Applicants can speak and understand Kannada.
 Working Plan Associate
 Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Age Limit:
 The maximum age limit is 35 years.
 Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Educational Qualification:
 Applicants must have completed their M.Sc. in Botany/Zoology/Forestry/Wildlife/Soil Sciences from a recognised University with at least 60% marks.
 Junior Project Fellow, Project Assistant
 Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Age Limit:
 The maximum age limit is 28 years.
 Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Educational Qualification:
 Junior Project Fellow - Applicants must have completed their M.Sc. in Forestry/Agroforestry/Botany/Environmental Science.
 Project Assistant - Applicants must have completed their B.Sc. in Forestry/Botany/Environmental Science.
 Scientific Consultant Grade I Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Age Limit:
 The maximum age limit is 40 years.
 Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Educational Qualification:
 Applicants must have completed their master's degree in economics or a relevant field from a recognised institution.
 Experience:
 Applicants must have relevant experience in climate change and related fields.
 Applicants must have experience in climate finance.
 Applicants must have more than 5 years up to 10 years of experience.

 Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Result
 The recruitment bodies will release the Forest Department Recruitment 2026 result on their official websites after the completion of all the stages involved in the exam pattern. Basically, the forest recruitment 2026 result will be released after the completion of the written exam, but if there is no written exam for the forest posts released, the result will be released after the completion of all stages.
 In PDF format, the forest recruitment result 2026 will be released mostly. The Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Result PDF consists of the candidates' names and roll numbers selected for the posts. The table below demonstrates the Forest Department Recruitment 2026 result once they are released.

 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
 Q: Where can I access the Karnataka Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Online Form? A: Candidates can access the Forest Department Recruitment 2026 online form on the official recruiting bodies' websites. 
 Q: What are the posts released by the Karnataka Forest Department? A: Forest Watcher and Elephant Kavadiga are the two posts released by the Karnataka Forest Department. 
 Q: How many vacancies are announced for forest watchers in the Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Karnataka? A: A total of 675 posts are announced for forest watcher/forest observer in the Karnataka Forest Department Recruitment 2026.
 Q: What are the posts announced by the Tripura Forest Department Recruitment? A: Recently, no posts were announced by the Tripura Forest Department Recruitment.
 Q: What is the Forest Department Application Form 2026 Last Date for the Kolara Tourism Gate Manager? A: The Forest Department Application Form 2026 Last Date for the Kolara Tourism Gate Manager is August 28, 2026. 
 Q: Where can I find the Forest Department 2026 apply online link? A: Candidates can find the forest department 2026 apply online link on the official websites of different states. 
 Q: What is the post announced by the Maharashtra Forest Department? A: Kolara Tourism Gate Manager is the post announced by the Maharashtra Forest Department.
 Q: Does the Uttarakhand Forest Department announce any Forest Department Recruitment 2026? A: Yes, the exam authority has released the Uttarakhand Forest Department Recruitment 2026 notification PDF to recruit eligible candidates for working plan associates.
